intro.heading: Sixteen cottages. Pick the one that fits your family.
intro.body: Each cabin is fully furnished with linens, a stocked kosher kitchen or kitchenette, climate control, and a private porch. Sizes range from one-room suites for couples to roomy 3.5-room cottages that sleep up to ten. Use the filters below to find the right fit.

cabins.name: The Birch Suite
cabins.shortDescription: A bright one-room suite with a queen bed, kitchenette, and a porch facing the woods.
cabins.longDescription: Our smallest and most peaceful cottage. The Birch Suite is a single open room with a queen bed, a kosher kitchenette (microwave, induction burner, fridge, sink), a full bath, and french doors opening onto a private porch. Ideal for couples or a parent traveling with one child.

cabins.name: The Maple Suite
cabins.shortDescription: One-room cottage with a queen bed plus a daybed nook — perfect for a small family.
cabins.longDescription: The Maple Suite adds a built-in daybed nook to the standard suite layout, giving you sleeping space for a third guest without sacrificing the open, airy feel. Includes a full kosher kitchenette and a covered porch.

cabins.name: The Cedar Suite
cabins.shortDescription: A cozy one-room retreat with a wood-burning stove and an oversized soaking tub.
cabins.longDescription: The Cedar Suite is built for slow weekends. A real wood-burning stove anchors the room; the bathroom features an oversized soaking tub. A favorite for anniversaries and quiet getaways.

cabins.name: The Pine Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Two-room cottage with a separate bedroom, full kosher kitchen, and a sunny living room.
cabins.longDescription: A separate bedroom (queen) plus a living room with a sleeper sofa, full kosher kitchen, dining table for four, and a wraparound porch. The Pine is our most popular two-room layout.

cabins.name: The Spruce Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Bedroom + bunk nook, full kitchen, and a stone fireplace in the living room.
cabins.longDescription: Spruce pairs a queen bedroom with a built-in bunk nook (two twins) for kids — they get their own space, you get a real night's sleep. Full kosher kitchen, stone fireplace, and a deck overlooking the pines.

cabins.name: The Hemlock Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Two queen bedrooms and a galley kitchen — built for grandparents-and-grandkids trips.
cabins.longDescription: Two equally-sized queen bedrooms, each with its own bath, share a central living area and galley kosher kitchen. Designed so multigenerational guests each get privacy without giving up the shared table.

cabins.name: The Aspen Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Two bedrooms plus a sleeping loft, full kitchen, and a screened porch.
cabins.longDescription: A queen primary, a kids' room with two twins, and a sleeping loft for an extra guest. Full kosher kitchen, screened porch, and a quiet wooded lot at the edge of the property.

cabins.name: The Willow Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Two bedrooms, a den with a pullout, full kitchen, and a fenced backyard.
cabins.longDescription: Willow's small den off the living room doubles as an extra sleeping space (queen pullout) and a quiet spot for a nursing mother or an early riser. The fenced backyard is a parent's best friend.

cabins.name: The Chestnut Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms, two baths, full kitchen, and a big front porch with rockers.
cabins.longDescription: The classic family layout: three bedrooms (queen + two twins x2), two full bathrooms, an open living-dining area, full kosher kitchen, and a deep porch with rocking chairs. Steps from the playground.

cabins.name: The Sycamore Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms, fireplace, full kitchen — our most-requested summer cabin.
cabins.longDescription: A queen primary plus two kids' rooms (one with bunks, one with twins), full kosher kitchen with an island, a wood-burning fireplace, and a wide deck. Books up fastest for July and August.

cabins.name: The Juniper Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms, two baths, mudroom — built for big families and lots of gear.
cabins.longDescription: Juniper's standout feature is the mudroom — a real one, with cubbies, hooks, and a utility sink. Three bedrooms, two baths, full kosher kitchen, and a back patio with a picnic table. Sleeps up to eight.

cabins.name: The Linden Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms with a separate family room — kids' wing on one side, parents' on the other.
cabins.longDescription: Linden splits the floor plan: the primary suite is on one end of the cottage, the two kids' bedrooms and family room on the other. Great for families with older children or two couples traveling together.

cabins.name: The Beech Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms plus a true office nook — workable Wi-Fi for the parent who can't unplug.
cabins.longDescription: Beech is our pick for families where one parent has to keep one foot in the office. Three bedrooms (queen + bunks + twins), a small den / office nook with a desk and dedicated mesh Wi-Fi, full kosher kitchen, two baths.

cabins.name: The Oak Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Our largest layout: three bedrooms, a bunk room, two baths, full kosher kitchen.
cabins.longDescription: Oak adds a dedicated bunk room (four built-in bunks) to the standard three-bedroom plan — perfect for cousins or a long Yom Tov with grandchildren visiting. Two full baths, full kosher kitchen with double oven, generous living-dining area, and a covered porch.

cabins.name: The Hickory Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms, finished basement playroom, sleeps ten — for the biggest gatherings.
cabins.longDescription: Hickory's secret weapon is the finished basement: a full playroom with toys, a sleeper sofa, and a half-bath. Upstairs, three bedrooms sleep seven; downstairs adds three more on the sleeper and a futon. The choice for extended families.

cabins.name: The Dogwood Cottage
cabins.shortDescription: Three bedrooms, library nook, screened porch — the quiet end of the property.
cabins.longDescription: Dogwood sits at the far end of the lane, where the woods are densest and the road noise disappears. Three bedrooms, a small library nook with a reading chair, a screened porch, and a full kosher kitchen. Sleeps up to nine.
